title: One Time Classroom Rewards Scoreboard

reasons: The operator asked for a visible classroom scoreboard for parents and students.
The request references rewards, ratings, published questions, and public classroom visibility.
The feature touches member/student portal UI and child/member privacy boundaries.
affected_product_surfaces: One Time moderation and gamification policy
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: Verify and deploy the approved-only classroom scoreboard.

operator_intent_summary: Add a clear One Time classroom scoreboard where parents/students can see positive reviewed participation such as published questions, answered questions, Rabbi-featured items, and review participation.
raw_quotes: in the classroom section we need to have some sort of like scoreboard
one of them is like you know the best questions
this guy got his question answered
anyone who gets like a question that is published and like made public for everyone so that should be like you know viewable
there should be like a section for everyone to see like the the scoreboard of you know where everyone's holding

decisions_captured.decision: A member-visible One Time classroom rewards scoreboard is approved when it counts only positive approved classroom-visible events.
This request does not approve an anonymous public leaderboard, negative points, public shame, prizes, coupons, payment credits, access grants, external notifications, or unreviewed text exposure.

out_of_scope: No raw private reply bodies, held responses, rejected messages, or unreviewed student text in the scoreboard.
No negative points, public discipline labels, prize, coupon, discount, payment credit, access grant, or external notification.
No email, WhatsApp, Telegram, Vimeo, Zoom, Stripe, Drive, DNS, GHL, or LeadConnector write.
No student-to-student chat or unmoderated forum feed.

inspection_targets: existing tests that previously required an empty leaderboard
observed: The classroom API previously returned an empty leaderboard array.
The classroom UI rendered approved participation but not a true scoreboard.

expanded_phrases.scoreboard: Member-visible, positive-only ranking of approved classroom participation with no private or negative data exposure.
expanded_phrases.rewards: Display labels and points for approved questions, approved answers, Rabbi-featured items, and assignment/review participation only.
expanded_phrases.best questions: Questions count only after Rabbi/admin approval or publication.
expanded_phrases.question answered: Approved response/answer events count as positive participation.
expanded_phrases.published: Only classroom-visible approved events are eligible for display.
expanded_phrases.viewable: Visible to authenticated/review One Time classroom users, not anonymous public visitors.
expanded_phrases.where everyone's holding: Show current positive point totals and rank without shame, penalties, or private text.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: The scoreboard is a first-party BNA One Time classroom feature, not an external forum, CRM, or community runtime.

requirements.statement: Add a member-visible One Time classroom rewards scoreboard.
requirements.expected_result: The classroom shows a compact positive scoreboard section after access is opened.
acceptance_criteria: The section title is Rewards Scoreboard.
Rows show rank, participant label, points, approved-count summary, and reward labels.
The empty state explains that approved rewards appear after Rabbi/admin review.

requirements.statement: Score only approved classroom-visible participation events.
requirements.expected_result: The API calculates points from approved question, approved answer, Rabbi-featured, and assignment/review participation events.
acceptance_criteria: The scoring formula is explicit and tested.
No raw private replies or unreviewed text appear.
No negative points or discipline labels appear.
No external send, charge, access grant, provider write, or reward fulfillment is performed.

criteria: Affected route is limited to One Time classroom.
Existing current-state code path has been inspected.
Approved-only data source and scoring formula are explicit.
Forbidden data and external writes are listed.

filtered_empty.test_smoke_assertion: Scoreboard remains stable without a filter control.
